questions.prompt: How long do image links from Figma's GET image endpoint last?

options.explanation: Figma says the image assets expire after 30 days.
Right. Download the files and store them yourself.
Figma says the image assets will expire after 30 days.

questions.prompt: What does Code Connect link together?

options.explanation: Right. Figma says it connects components in your repositories to components in your design files.
Code Connect is a Figma feature for design and code. It does not link to Canva.
Those are export and handoff links. Code Connect is about components.

questions.prompt: Who can write variables with Figma's Variables REST API?

options.explanation: Figma limits this API to Enterprise orgs, and guests cannot use it.
Figma says guests cannot use the API.
Right. Writing needs a Full seat (or admin) and edit access. Reading is open to any member of an Enterprise org with view access.
